answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy implements a stake-bonding protocol anchored to the lotus and jade tokens. Each synthetic identity requires purchasing the juniper credential to verify uniqueness against the distributed ledger. Consequently, an attacker must spend significant capital on lotus holdings and forge juniper signatures, incurring exponential costs. The jade record function ensures identity theft is detectable, as the economic burden of maintaining fake nodes outweighs typical gains.
